faq.question: Chat Live Seller
faq.answer: Connecting you directly to our live Facebook Messenger inbox! Our multi-admin team is ready to assist you with inquiries, custom flavor orders, and bulk delivery.

faq.question: Can I pick up my order?
faq.answer:
Yes! You can choose 'Store Pickup' at checkout with ₱0 shipping fee.
📍 Pickup Location: J-Pop Corner, Poblacion, San Juan, Abra.
⏱️ Prep Time: 15–30 minutes fresh from popping/frying. You will receive a ready-for-pickup notification!

faq.question: My Area is not listed on the shipping options.
faq.answer: If your exact barangay or municipality outside Abra isn't listed, simply choose 'Store Pickup' or message our Live Seller on Facebook Messenger with your exact address. We partner with local courier and bus dispatch services for special delivery quotes!

faq.question: Operating Hours
faq.answer:
🕒 Store Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM.
⏰ Order Cut-off: 7:30 PM for same-day delivery or pickup. Orders placed after cut-off are queued for next morning popping!

faq.question: Payment methods
faq.answer:
We support 3 flexible payment methods:
1. 💵 Cash (Cash on Delivery or Cash on Pickup)
2. 📱 Manual QR Ph / E-Wallet (GCash, Maya, InstaPay bank transfer with receipt upload)
3. 💳 Automated Online Gateway (Credit/Debit cards, Maya & QR Ph via PayMongo / HitPay)
